thread:
maria: Starting prod deploy for service inference-api v2.14. We plan to use a circuit-breaker holdback for the feature flag `ff.predictive-cache`: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with short health windows. Deploy window 22:00-23:00 PT. @sam are you on-call?
sam: oncall tonight, good to go. keep me in #eng-oncall for alerts.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by maria at 1887654321. Target: prod-dc-3. Canary: canary-3 (5 instances). Version: v2.14-build.987.
jordan: propose safety holdback rule: if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 400ms for 5m, auto-failover toggle `ff.predictive-cache` -> 0% and pin traffic to v2.13.
maria: yes. add circuit-breaker metric checks and slack alert to #incidents and pager.
kai: adding rollout policy snippet:
```
{
  "flag": "ff.predictive-cache",
  "phases": [
    {"duration_min": 10, "pct": 1},
    {"duration_min": 20, "pct": 5},
    {"duration_min": 30, "pct": 25}
  ]
}
```
maria: will run canary with `--pin-version=v2.14` on the canary group for the first 10 minutes.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: infra:inference-api:5xx_rate > 0.005 for 5m -> notify #incidents, @sam pager, run `infra/rollback.sh`.
sam: added smoke tests to run at each phase. If any smoke fails, manual hold and rollback.
dawn: note: I'll update release notes with flag behavior and rollback steps.
jordan: also adding model-fallback: if cache misses spike > 3x baseline, fallback to `model-small` for 10m.
maria: agreed. post-deploy monitoring window 60m after full rollout. If no regressions, we'll remove holdback and mark release done.
sam: I'll watch dashboards. ping me @ 22:15 if it hits phase 2.
deploy-bot: Canary passed. Phase 1 (1%) complete at 1887654380.
maria: moving to phase 2 (5%). toggling flag to 5% in prod.
deploy-bot: Phase 2 complete at 1887654400. No alerts. Rolling out phase 3.
jordan: hold on, seeing slight uptick in p95 at one region, but still within threshold, keeping an eye.
maria: phase 3 toggled to 25% at 1887654440.
ops-bot: Metric alert: infra:inference-api:p95_latency > 0.4s in eu-west for 3m. Initiating circuit-breaker.
maria: executing rollback: toggle `ff.predictive-cache` -> 0% and pin router to v2.13. /deploy rollback started.
deploy-bot: Rollback started at 1887654450. Traffic pinned to v2.13. Canary scaled back.
sam: confirmed rollback, monitoring. filing postmortem draft.
dawn: adding note to release notes: "release aborted due to p95 latency regression in eu-west; rolled back to v2.13; follow-up: investigate cache warmup and kernel config."
maria: thanks team. Will reopen in 48h for reattempt after fixes.
